newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Philippnes President Ramos arrives in Bangladesh.
newsitem.headline: Philippnes President Ramos arrives in Bangladesh.

text.p: Philippines President Fidel Ramos arrived in Dhaka to a red-carpet reception on Wednesday for a three-day visit to Bangladesh that officials said was aimed at expanding bilateral trade and economic cooperation.

Bangladesh President Shahabuddin Ahmed and Prime Minister Sheikh Hasina received Ramos as he flew in from the Indian capital New Delhi on the second leg of his five-nation tour of South Asia and the Middle East.

Ramos, the first Philipino President visiting Bangladesh, is leading a 120-member delegation which include his Foreign Secretary Domingo L. Siazon, Trade and Industry minister Cesar B. Bautista and some 50 top business figures.
Government officials said reactivation of some previously signed agreements on trade and economic relations would top the agenda of the official talks between Ramos and Hasina later on Wednesday.
"The two leaders may discuss the revival of the Joint Economic Commission between Dhaka and Manila and can agree on its meeting at an early date," one official said.
The Filipino leader will meet the President Shahbuddin Ahmed and several ministers.
He will also visit a project of the rural Grameen Bank and meet local business community before leaving for Pakistan on Friday.
